t: Fit-check caching — stamp idea lugs with corpus hash to skip redundant scans
challenge: Backlog review re-runs the fit check for every idea against current state, even when the lug corpus hasn't changed — this is expensive and produces no new information in stable periods
hypothesis: If we stamp each idea lug with a fit_checked_at timestamp and a lightweight corpus hash (open lug count + latest lug ID + latest skill version), then during backlog review any idea whose hash still matches can skip the fit re-check, making backlog review O(changed) rather than O(all)
agent_framing: Add corpus hash to idea lugs so backlog review can skip unchanged ideas — implement when backlog size makes scan cost noticeable

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Improvement idea — adds caching to the fit check for large backlogs.
